actions.name: curve left on black, wheels 10 % and 40 %
curve right on the floor, wheels 40 % and 10 %

control_flow: followInTheDark: if the right light is below 60, then if the left light is below 45 curve left, else if the line tracker is above 95 curve right, else avoidWalls; otherwise avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if the left light is below 70, then if a wall is left turn right, else if a wall is right turn left, else driveInTheDark; otherwise driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 drive forward, else stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if a wall is ahead stop, else followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black curve left, else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, also inside a dim tunnel where the light is low.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads less than 60 %

branches.outcome: the right light is below 60: go into the dark handling
the right light is not below 60: avoidWalls

decision_points.condition: first: the left light is below 45 %; second: the line tracker reads more than 95 %

branches.outcome: the left light is below 45: curve left
the left light is not below 45 and the line tracker is above 95: curve right

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads less than 70 %

branches.outcome: the left light is below 70: check for walls
the left light is not below 70: driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: first: a wall is on the left; second: a wall is on the right

branches.outcome: a wall is on the left: turn right by 20°
no wall left and a wall is on the right: turn left by 20°
no wall on either side: driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads less than 70 %

branches.outcome: the left light is below 70: drive forward at 30 %
the left light is not below 70: stopAtWall
